outline_first.description: Index of the first outline entry in this unit.

outline_last.description: Index of the last outline entry in this unit; equal to outline_first for a one-entry unit.

question.description: Write this first: the one question every part of this unit helps answer. If you cannot write one question, change the range.

summary.description: One or two sentences that synthesize the whole unit.

title.description: Written after the question: a short title by role. Setup and method units name what they set up; result and interpretation units state the finding. Not a breadcrumb of the paper's own headings, and not two topics joined by 'and'.

sections.description: Reading units as contiguous ranges of the given outline entries, in order, without gaps or overlaps. Group headings that answer the same question; a printed section that is already one idea may be its own unit.

description: The paper's reading map as ranges of its outline.
